name: What is the process for modernizing a room with Frasheski Construction?
description: We consult, plan, execute construction including permits and quality control, and maintain open communication until completion.

mainEntity.name: What is the process for modernizing a room with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. We then develop a detailed proposal and design plan. Once approved, we handle all aspects of the construction, from securing permits to managing subcontractors and ensuring quality control. We maintain open communication throughout the project, keeping you updated on progress until completion and final walkthrough.
